model_interpretation.claim: The measured synchronous 16×16 output tile with K=16 staging provides a control for a two-buffer version with the same lane and compute mapping. Issuing 4-byte cp.async loads for the next K stage while computing the current stage may hide some global-to-shared latency on the supplied GH200 target, though copy and synchronization overhead could instead make it slower. No async speedup is claimed before measurement.
